data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 第一次的章鱼烧
data.description: 祭典摊位，她对着章鱼烧又吹又扇，被烫得直呼气却舍不得吐出来；终于咽下去后高举竹签宣布「人类的食物是宝物」，是最典型的十香式感动。

data.promptProse: At the festival stall, Tohka blows carefully on a steaming takoyaki bite held above its tray with a bamboo pick. Her violet yukata sleeve is gathered away from the food; puffed cheeks and widened eyes show its lingering heat. The medium portrait places the stall counter below her hands and lanterns beyond it. Their warm light illuminates steam and the glossy bite, casting small shadows beneath the tray.
